description: Mara driving downtown at 10:00, towers ahead, traffic on the avenue, pedestrians on the sidewalk, HUD, minimap and job tracker live.
Three-star police ram run in golden late-afternoon light during the Hot Delivery job, traffic ahead, RAM RUN warning on the HUD.
Fishing off the east pier at golden hour 17:30, bobber on the bay, Biscuit at her heel, the second island and its lighthouse across the water.
Storm night at 22:00 on the beachfront, lamps glowing, moon up, lightning, rain, Mara's car at the intersection, downtown towers and traffic with headlights.
